_note: v2.5 plan 12 F1 live gate on the DEV build (no model call). Serve dev first: npm run build:dev && npm run serve:dev, then node scripts/debug/st-session.mts reload (a lane: st-lanes.mts run <n> -- scripts/debug/st-session.mts reload). Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/live-v25-12-lazy-chunks.json --sandbox --group <group id>. Proves the lazy author tabs and the lazy Studio load from ST's served dist/ (every chunk 200, rendered), and that author view off shows none of them. The artifact half (prod bundle) is so-artifact-smoke.mts probe.

steps.eval: performance.setResourceTimingBufferSize(performance.getEntriesByType('resource').length + 1000); for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((name) => name.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const chunks = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => /story-orchestrator\/dist\/\d+\.index\.js/.test(entry.name)).map((entry) => entry.name); globalThis.__so12ChunksBefore = chunks; return { chunksBefore: chunks.length };

const panel = document.querySelector('#drawer-manager [data-so-tab="scheduler"]'); if (!panel) throw new Error('the Scheduler tab never finished loading its chunk'); if (!(panel.textContent ?? '').includes('Extraction')) throw new Error(`the Scheduler tab rendered without its content: ${(panel.textContent ?? '').slice(0, 120)}`); return { scheduler: true };
if (!document.querySelector('#drawer-manager [data-so-tab="payload"] #so-next-turn')) throw new Error('the Payload tab did not render the next-turn preview'); return { payload: true };

const until = async (probe, ms) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; while (Date.now() < end) { const value = probe(); if (value) return value; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } return null; }; const modal = await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-studio-modal[open]'), 15000); if (!modal) throw new Error('the Studio modal never opened from its lazy chunk'); const loaded = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').filter((entry) => /story-orchestrator\/dist\/\d+\.index\.js/.test(entry.name)); const fresh = loaded.filter((entry) => !globalThis.__so12ChunksBefore.includes(entry.name)); const failed = loaded.filter((entry) => entry.responseStatus !== undefined && entry.responseStatus !== 200 && entry.responseStatus !== 0); if (fresh.length < 3) throw new Error(`expected the author tabs and the Studio to load at least 3 chunks, saw ${fresh.length}: ${fresh.map((entry) => entry.name).join(', ')}`); if (failed.length) throw new Error(`chunk requests failed: ${failed.map((entry) => `${entry.name} ${entry.responseStatus}`).join(', ')}`); return { chunks: fresh.map((entry) => entry.name.split('/').pop()) };

globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500)); const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#drawer-manager [role="tablist"] button')].map((button) => (button.textContent ?? '').trim()); if (tabs.some((label) => ['Blackboard', 'Scheduler', 'Payload'].includes(label))) throw new Error(`player mode still lists an author tab: ${tabs.join(', ')}`); if (document.querySelector('#drawer-manager [data-so-tab]')) throw new Error('an author tab body is still mounted in player mode'); return { tabs };

_v26: T7 2026-10-03: run 2 saw 0 fresh chunks because run 1 had already loaded the author tabs and the Studio into the same page (a loaded webpack chunk is never fetched again). Step 1 reloads the page first (so-scenario reloadStep: page.reload, wait for the runtime, reopen the sandbox chat), so every run counts the chunks of ONE page load against that load's own startup set; the >= 3 fresh chunks, every-chunk-200 and player-mode checks are unchanged.
